<thought>We have a mass spectrum with a dominant peak at m/z 179.0946, which in positive‑mode ESI is most likely the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of about 178.0873 Da. Searching for plausible organic formulas that match this mass, the composition C₇H₁₄O₅ (C = 7 × 12.0000 = 84.0000 Da, H = 14 × 1.007825 = 14.10955 Da, O = 5 × 15.994915 = 79.974575 Da) sums to 178.0841 Da, within a few millidaltons of the observed mass, making it the best fit. No other reasonable combination of C, H, O, N, or halogens matches as closely. Hence the molecular formula is C₇H₁₄O₅.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
